description: This file defines the ImageFactory class in Drupal, responsible for creating image objects and retrieving supported image extensions, utilizing an ImageToolkitManager.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Image\ImageFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating image objects and managing image toolkit settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImageFactory with an ImageToolkitManager instance.

methods.name: setToolkitId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the image toolkit to be used by the factory.

methods.name: getToolkitId
methods.description: Retrieves the current image toolkit ID, defaulting if not set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Image object with optional source and toolkit ID.

methods.name: getSupportedExtensions
methods.description: Returns supported image file extensions for a given or current toolkit.
